quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the Celtics' 27-point comeback against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes it's not your night. He was like, give you guys about five to seven minutes.
quotes.quote: I remember that night we were down 27 at the half. Brad Stevens came in the halftime and he told the starters basically, sometimes it's not your night. He was like, give you guys about five to seven minutes. If we can't make a dent into the lead, then we're probably going to let the young guys play the night. We were down 27, we came back to win in overtime. It was crazy.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his deep connection with Nelly and St. Louis
quotes.excerpt: I got a tattoo on my back that says U City. U City is University City.
quotes.quote: I got a bunch of tattoos. All my tattoos are specific to my life. I got a tattoo on my back that says U City. U City is University City, the neighborhood that Nelly grew up in, Brad Beal grew up in, and I grew up in. Nelly went to U City High School, my mom went to U City High School. Nelly, being the biggest person probably to ever come out of St. Louis, and to take it a step further, us being from the same neighborhood. My parents have known Nelly since they were kids and essentially known me my whole life. We've gotten a lot closer in the last 10-12 years. He's somebody that I got a lot of respect for, and the whole city of St. Louis is really thankful for. He put St. Louis on the map and shined a light on the city.
